reviews.text: We love Walkie Doggie Toronto! Spice loves spending time with them and is always excited to go  on her walks with Andy, highly recommended !!

Andy and Cesar are amazing. I leave my energetic 1.5 year old dog with them and they take care of him so well. They send pictures throughout the day to keep me updated, they have such a great kind demeanour. My dog gets so excited when he sees either of them, so that makes me feel reassured that the love is mutual.

A few months back Andy also watched my senior dog of 16.5 years old, and wow she was treated with extremely special care. I was very impressed with how well she was accommodated and kept safe.

So yes. I have left two of my pets with Andy and Cesar and both experiences were fantastic.

Thank you Andy and Cesar for the love and support of my amazing doggies.

Walkie Doggie have been caring for our Evi for almost 1 year now.  She always greets them happily and gets lots of pets and cuddles while staying there.  They send photos with her every day.  Thank you Walkie Doggie for caring for our sweet girl!
They truly are dog whisperers. All the dogs in my building absolutely love them:) very warm and friendly always and the dogs just run to them with wagging happy tails!

My experience with Walkie Doggie has been amazing; they truly aren't your typical dog walking and boarding service. Cesar is the absolute sweetest with my dog, Lola. She can be a bit difficult sometimes, but he is always patient and loving, which has really helped improve her behavior. She has also stayed over for 'sleepovers'—as they call them—several times, and she truly feels right at home. They keep me updated on everything that happens with her, sending photos and updates of everything she does. Plus, they always have sweet little gestures for the pet parents. I feel so lucky to have found them!
Andy is the best, you can not find a kindest and nicest person than her ❤️ my dog loves her so much, she became part of our family❤️

I no longer use Walkie Doggy's services.

On June 13, 2026, Walkie Doggy walked my two dogs around 5:30pm. They reported that the dogs were back home shortly after 6pm and that the walk went well. My 1.5 year old, healthy, 22lb mutt, Mia was in her crate at home before the walk and was returned to her crate afterward. During the walk itself she was on leash in the walkers' care the entire time, which they confirmed. That evening, I returned home to find Mia in her crate in severe medical distress — she had vomited and defecated in the crate and could barely stand or breathe. I took her to VEG emergency veterinary hospital in Etobicoke, where she was found to be in circulatory shock with dangerously low blood pressure and signs of acute liver injury. She required emergency stabilization, including epinephrine, IV fluids, and a plasma transfusion, and was hospitalized for roughly two days. The emergency veterinarians' working assessment was anaphylaxis, with toxin exposure considered as an alternative. They could not confirm when or where the triggering exposure occurred. The total cost of her emergency and follow-up care was approximately $8,000. Her liver is still showing signs of severe damage in her bloodwork nearly two weeks later. We’re hopeful it will heal.
After Mia's recovery, I raised the question of the veterinary costs with Walkie Doggy. They expressed concern for Mia, but declined to contribute to the costs, taking the position that the cause of her illness had not been established and that there was no proof it occurred during their care. I was invoiced for the walk in question and paid it in full. I no longer use their services.
